Thank you for contributing!

Please take some time to make it easier for us to review your pull request:

- Describe clearly what you're changing, why, and how you verified the change.
- Use clear and concise commit messages to help us understand and review your PR.
- Tell us how you use protobuf-es, and whether you used AI tools.

---

**How do you use protobuf-es?** A sentence about your project, or what you were working on. If you don't use it, just say so, and what led you to this change.

**Did you use AI tools?** Use your own words to describe how you used the tools. Write "None" if you used none.
